title: Third Party Patcher (com.gilburns.patcher)
description: Configuration settings for the Third Party Patcher tool

DeferralCountdownSeconds.title: Deferral Countdown Seconds
DeferralCountdownSeconds.description: Seconds of countdown in the deferral prompt before the automatic action fires.

DeferralAutomaticAction.title: Deferral Automatic Action
DeferralAutomaticAction.description: Action when the deferral countdown expires with no user input: "defer" (postpone to next cycle) or "kill" (force-quit blocking app and apply).

DeferralTimerDefault.title: Deferral Timer Default
DeferralTimerDefault.description: Default deferral duration in minutes applied when the user accepts without choosing a custom time (4 hours).

DeferralTimerMenu.title: Deferral Timer Menu
DeferralTimerMenu.description: Comma-separated list of deferral durations in minutes shown in the pop-up menu.

DeferralTimerFocus.title: Deferral Timer Focus
DeferralTimerFocus.description: The number of minutes to defer the update restart dialog automatically if a process has prevented display sleep (for example, during an active meeting) or the user has Focus or Do Not Disturb enabled

PatchingWeekday.title: Patching Weekday
PatchingWeekday.description: Day of the week for the patch window: 1=Sunday, 2=Monday, 3=Tuesday … 7=Saturday.

PatchingWeekOfMonth.title: Patching Week Of Month
PatchingWeekOfMonth.description: Which occurrence of `PatchingWeekday` in the month: 1=first, 2=second, etc.

PatchingStartTime.title: Patching Start Time
PatchingStartTime.description: Earliest time to begin applying on patch day (24-hour `HH:MM`). Empty = no lower bound.

PatchingEndTime.title: Patching End Time
PatchingEndTime.description: Latest time to begin applying on patch day (24-hour `HH:MM`). Apply will not start a new run after this time.

DialogOnTop.title: Dialog On Top
DialogOnTop.description: When `true`, the swiftDialog window floats above all other windows.

UnattendedExit.title: Unattended Exit
UnattendedExit.description: When `true`, the apply completion dialog closes automatically after `UnattendedExitSeconds` if the user does not interact.

UnattendedExitSeconds.title: Unattended Exit Seconds
UnattendedExitSeconds.description: Seconds before the apply completion dialog auto-closes when `UnattendedExit` is `true`.

BlockingProcessAction.title: Blocking Process Action
BlockingProcessAction.description: Action when a blocking process is running during apply: `"ignore"` (skip the check entirely), `"kill"` (force-quit silently), `"notify"` (brief notification; skip label if still running), `"prompt"` (timed dialog; user can quit or skip), `"defer"` (skip silently; retry next cycle).

BlockingProcessCountdownSeconds.title: Blocking Process Countdown Seconds
BlockingProcessCountdownSeconds.description: Seconds of countdown in the blocking process prompt before the automatic action fires.

DialogIcon.title: Dialog Icon
DialogIcon.description: Path to a custom icon for the apply dialog. Empty = use the system computer icon. Supports absolute paths, `SF=<symbol>` notation, or an SF Symbol name directly.

UseOverlayIcon.title: Use Overlay Icon
UseOverlayIcon.description: When `true`, a small overlay icon is composited onto the dialog icon. Automatically disabled when swiftDialog is not installed.

OverlayIcon.title: Overlay Icon
OverlayIcon.description: Path to the overlay icon image. Empty = auto-detect from known MDM agents (Jamf, Intune, etc.).

DialogScreenPosition.title: Dialog Screen Position
DialogScreenPosition.description: Position of the main apply dialog: `topleft`, `left`, `bottomleft`, `top`, `center`, `bottom`, `topright`, `right`, or `bottomright`.

DialogScreenProgressPosition.title: Dialog Screen Progress Position
DialogScreenProgressPosition.description: Position of the progress/status window during apply. Same position values as `DialogScreenPosition`.

DownloadBandwidthLimit.title: Download Bandwidth Limit
DownloadBandwidthLimit.description: curl `--limit-rate` format bandwidth cap for staged downloads (e.g. `"500K"` for 500 KB/s, `"2M"` for 2 MB/s). Empty string = unlimited.

StageDownloadFailThreshold.title: Stage Download Fail Threshold
StageDownloadFailThreshold.description: Consecutive download or verification failures before a label is marked broken and skipped by the stage phase.

ApplyFailThreshold.title: Apply Fail Threshold
ApplyFailThreshold.description: Consecutive install failures before a staged update is abandoned and that version is blocked from re-staging. Staging resumes automatically when a newer version becomes available.

IgnoreUnknownVersionLabels.title: Ignore Unknown Version Labels
IgnoreUnknownVersionLabels.description: When `true`, labels that return no `appNewVersion` value are skipped entirely during staging.

UnknownVersionCheckIntervalDays.title: Unknown Version Check Interval Days
UnknownVersionCheckIntervalDays.description: For labels with unknown versions, re-check this many days after the last attempt (instead of the normal `CheckIntervalHours` cadence).

VersionMismatchThrottleDays.title: Version Mismatch Throttle Days
VersionMismatchThrottleDays.description: When a label reports a version that does not match the file actually downloaded, suppress re-staging for this many days. Cleared automatically when the label reports a different `appNewVersion`.

InitialScanDelayEnabled.title: Initial Scan Delay Enabled
InitialScanDelayEnabled.description: When `true`, a one-time random delay is applied before the first scan after initial deployment. Spreads fleet-wide first-scan load across the `InitialScanDelayMaxSeconds` window.

InitialScanDelayMaxSeconds.title: Initial Scan Delay Max Seconds
InitialScanDelayMaxSeconds.description: Maximum jitter for the initial deployment delay in seconds (default: 24 hours). The actual delay is chosen randomly in `[0, max]` on first launch and persisted.

ScanIntervalDays.title: Scan Interval Days
ScanIntervalDays.description: Days between full application scans. A full scan re-evaluates all Installomator labels to discover installed apps.

ScanOnLabelUpdate.title: Scan On Label Update
ScanOnLabelUpdate.description: When `true`, a scan is triggered immediately if the Installomator or Managed Labels have been updated since the last scan, regardless of `ScanIntervalDays`.

LightScanIntervalHours.title: Light Scan Interval Hours
LightScanIntervalHours.description: Hours between light scan runs. A light scan checks uninstalled labels for apps that may have been installed by other means, without re-running label scripts or hitting the network for non-installed labels.

CheckIntervalHours.title: Check Interval Hours
CheckIntervalHours.description: Hours between check runs. A check reads installed versions for already-discovered apps to detect whether an update is needed.

StageIntervalHours.title: Stage Interval Hours
StageIntervalHours.description: Hours between stage runs. The stage phase downloads pending updates.

ApplyIntervalHours.title: Apply Interval Hours
ApplyIntervalHours.description: Minimum hours between apply runs in deadline-based patching mode. Prevents apply from running every 10-minute cycle once updates are pending. Not used in monthly patching mode — the patch-day window controls timing.

IgnoredLabels.title: Ignored Labels
IgnoredLabels.description: A space-separated list of Installomator labels to ignore for the TPP workflow. Supports wildcards, for example "microsoft*". A single "*" ignores every Installomator label except those listed in Required Labels and Optional Labels.

IgnoreManagedApps.title: Ignore Managed Apps
IgnoreManagedApps.description: When `true`, automatically detects apps whose updates are already controlled by MDM policies and excludes their labels from patching. Currently detects Microsoft 365/Office (via MAU), Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, and Google Drive.

IgnoreNonProductionLabels.title: Ignore Non Production Labels
IgnoreNonProductionLabels.description: When `true`, automatically ignores non-production label variants — labels whose name ends with one of `NonProductionLabelSuffixes` — but only when a production label of the same base name also exists. E.g. with the default suffixes, `microsoftedgebeta` and `microsoftedgedev` are ignored because `microsoftedge` also exists as a label; a label like `figma` is untouched, and a hypothetical `somethingbeta` is left alone if `something` is not also a known label.

NonProductionLabelSuffixes.title: Non Production Label Suffixes
NonProductionLabelSuffixes.description: Space-separated list of suffixes that mark a label as a non-production variant of a base label. Only used when `IgnoreNonProductionLabels` is `true`. Does not support wildcards.

PreferPkgLabels.title: Prefer Pkg Labels
PreferPkgLabels.description: When a label and its `pkg`-suffixed counterpart both exist (e.g. `bbedit` and `bbeditpkg`), only one should ever be active — they deliver the same app via different installer mechanisms. When `true`, the pkg-suffixed label is preferred and the non-pkg label is ignored. When `false`, the non-pkg label is preferred and the pkg-suffixed label is ignored instead.

RequiredLabels.title: Required Labels
RequiredLabels.description: a space-separated list of Installomator labels that are required, regardless if the app is installed or or the latest version. Supports wildcards.

OptionalLabels.title: Optional Labels
OptionalLabels.description: Space-separated list of label names made available for user-initiated self-service installation via the Available Software catalog. Does not support wildcards. Labels are presented in the order listed here, allowing you to feature priority apps at the top. Example: `"microsoftword zoom slack"`.

SwiftDialogEnabled.title: Swift Dialog Enabled
SwiftDialogEnabled.description: Show swiftDialog prompts during the apply phase. If `false` (or swiftDialog is not installed), blocking process handling falls back to the configured `BlockingProcessAction`.

AppTitle.title: App Title
AppTitle.description: Allows you to customize the name of Third Party Patcher to something else

BrandColorFont.title: Brand Color Font
BrandColorFont.description: Font color used in dialogs and apps. These values set the accent colors used in swiftDialog prompts. Each accepts a standard Apple color name (`black`, `blue`, `gray`, `green`, `orange`, `pink`, `purple`, `red`, `white`, `yellow`) or a hex value (e.g. `#00A4C7`).

BrandColorBackground.title: Brand Color Background
BrandColorBackground.description: Background color used in dialogs and apps. These values set the accent colors used in swiftDialog prompts. Each accepts a standard Apple color name (`black`, `blue`, `gray`, `green`, `orange`, `pink`, `purple`, `red`, `white`, `yellow`) or a hex value (e.g. `#00A4C7`).

LogVerbose.title: Log Verbose
LogVerbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging. When `true`, per-label key dumps and other low-signal output are included in `/Library/Logs/Patcher/`.

LogRetentionDays.title: Log Retention Days
LogRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain log files in `/Library/Logs/Patcher/`. Files older than this are deleted during the `cleanLogs` run. Set to `0` to disable automatic log cleanup.

IgnoreAppsInHomeFolder.title: Ignore Apps In Home Folder
IgnoreAppsInHomeFolder.description: Ignore apps found in '/Users/'. If an update is found in '/Users/' and variable is set to false, the app will be updated into the application's default path

ConvertAppsInHomeFolder.title: Convert Apps In Home Folder
ConvertAppsInHomeFolder.description: This will convert any apps found in the users home folder to the /Applications folder

IgnoreAppsOnExternalVolumes.title: Ignore Apps On External Volumes
IgnoreAppsOnExternalVolumes.description: When `true`, apps found only on external volumes (`/Volumes/*`) are excluded from discovery and never updated. Useful in environments where external drives are transient and should not be managed.

InstallomatorGitHubAccount.title: Installomator GitHub Account
InstallomatorGitHubAccount.description: GitHub account hosting the Installomator label repository.

InstallomatorGitHubRepo.title: Installomator GitHub Repo
InstallomatorGitHubRepo.description: GitHub repository name for Installomator labels.

InstallomatorGitHubBranch.title: Installomator GitHub Branch
InstallomatorGitHubBranch.description: The name of the branch you want to use in your custom repo, typically main.

InstallomatorLabelsDisable.title: Installomator Labels Disable
InstallomatorLabelsDisable.description: When `true`, disables all Installomator label management: no initial download, no update checks, and Installomator labels are never used. Only Managed-Labels are used.

InstallomatorUpdateDisable.title: Installomator Update Disable
InstallomatorUpdateDisable.description: When `true`, skips routine label update checks while still using labels already on disk. Has no effect on the initial download when no labels are present. Ignored when `InstallomatorLabelsDisable` is `true`.

InstallomatorGitHubMetadataAccount.title: Installomator GitHub Metadata Account
InstallomatorGitHubMetadataAccount.description: GitHub account hosting the Installomator Metadata repository.

InstallomatorGitHubMetadataRepo.title: Installomator GitHub Metadata Repo
InstallomatorGitHubMetadataRepo.description: GitHub repository name for Installomator Metadata.

MetadataSyncEnabled.title: Metadata Sync Enabled
MetadataSyncEnabled.description: When `true`, the scheduler periodically checks the metadata repository for updates and syncs icons and metadata to a local cache.

MetadataSyncIntervalDays.title: Metadata Sync Interval Days
MetadataSyncIntervalDays.description: Days between metadata repository sync checks.

SupportTeamName.title: Support Team Name
SupportTeamName.description: Display name for your IT team in the Help Message

SupportTeamEmail.title: Support Team Email
SupportTeamEmail.description: Support email address. Shown as a clickable `mailto:` link in the Help Message

SupportTeamPhone.title: Support Team Phone
SupportTeamPhone.description: Support phone number in the Help Message. Set to `"None"` to hide the field.

SupportTeamWebsite.title: Support Team Website
SupportTeamWebsite.description: Support portal URL in the Help Message. Set to `"None"` to hide the field.

ShowMenuBarApp.title: Show Menu Bar App
ShowMenuBarApp.description: When `true`, the scheduler installs and loads the PatcherMenu LaunchAgent for the current console user. When `false`, the LaunchAgent is unloaded and the plist removed. Managed automatically at each scheduler run.

MenuBarIcon.title: Menu Bar Icon
MenuBarIcon.description: Icon displayed in the menu bar status item. Accepts an SF Symbol name (e.g. `"gear"`) or an absolute path to a template-mode PNG. A template PNG adapts automatically to light/dark menu bar appearance. Empty = built-in default.

ShowHelpButton.title: Show Help Button
ShowHelpButton.description: When `true`, a Help (?) button is shown in the menu bar popover header. Tapping it displays the support contact information.

ShowActivitySection.title: Show Activity Section
ShowActivitySection.description: When `true`, the Last Activity section (scan / check / stage / apply dates) is shown in the menu bar popover.

MenuDeferralCountDisplay.title: Menu Deferral Count Display
MenuDeferralCountDisplay.description: Controls how the deferral count line is shown in the popover. `combined` — one total covering every deferral, including auto-deferrals (timer time-outs and blocking-process skips). `split` — two figures: deferrals the user actively chose, and auto-deferrals combined. `userOnly` — only the count of deferrals the user actively chose.

ShowQuitButton.title: Show Quit Button
ShowQuitButton.description: When `true`, a Quit button is shown in the menu bar popover footer.

ShowMenuDownloadAction.title: Show Menu Download Action
ShowMenuDownloadAction.description: When `true`, the "Download New Updates" option appears in the Run Now menu.

ShowMenuCheckAction.title: Show Menu Check Action
ShowMenuCheckAction.description: When `true`, the "Check for Updates" option appears in the Run Now menu.

ShowMenuScanAction.title: Show Menu Scan Action
ShowMenuScanAction.description: When `true`, the "Full Discovery Scan" option appears in the Run Now menu.

ShowScanCheckProgressDialog.title: Show Scan Check Progress Dialog
ShowScanCheckProgressDialog.description: When `true`, scan and check operations triggered from PatcherMenu display a swiftDialog progress window.

CompanyName.title: Company Name
CompanyName.description: Organization name shown in the Available Software sidebar header above the app title.

CustomAppIconPath.title: Custom App Icon Path
CustomAppIconPath.description: Absolute path to a PNG or ICNS file used as the Available Software app icon, overriding the built-in icon in the Dock, Finder, and app switcher. Empty = use the default built-in icon.

AddToDockOnSelfServiceInstall.title: Add To Dock On Self Service Install
AddToDockOnSelfServiceInstall.description: When `true`, apps successfully installed via self-service are automatically added to the current user's Dock if not already present.

WebhookFeature.title: Webhook Feature
WebhookFeature.description: Controls when scheduled webhook reports are sent: `"FALSE"` (never), `"FAILURES"` (failures only), `"ALL"` (successes and failures).

WebhookAttributes.title: Webhook Attributes
WebhookAttributes.description: Comma-separated list of device attributes included in webhook payloads, in display order. MDM info is always appended if detected. Supported values: `deviceName`, `hostname`, `serial`, `osVersion`, `osBuild`, `osName`, `model`, `hardwareModel`, `user`, `patcherVersion`, `installomatorVersion`.

WebhookSchedule.title: Webhook Schedule
WebhookSchedule.description: When to send accumulated webhook reports: `"immediate"`, `"daily"`, `"weekly"`, `"monthly"`, or `"patchDay"`.

WebhookScheduleWeekday.title: Webhook Schedule Weekday
WebhookScheduleWeekday.description: For `weekly` schedule: day of week to send (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday).

WebhookScheduleMonthDay.title: Webhook Schedule Month Day
WebhookScheduleMonthDay.description: For `monthly` schedule: day of month to send (1–31).

WebhookScheduleHour.title: Webhook Schedule Hour
WebhookScheduleHour.description: For `daily`, `weekly`, and `monthly` schedules: hour of day (0–23) at which to send.

WebhookStageFailureThreshold.title: Webhook Stage Failure Threshold
WebhookStageFailureThreshold.description: Minimum consecutive stage failures for a label before it is included in webhook notifications.

WebhookSelfServiceFeature.title: Webhook Self Service Feature
WebhookSelfServiceFeature.description: Controls whether an immediate webhook is sent after a user-initiated self-service install, regardless of `WebhookSchedule`. Options: `"FALSE"` (never), `"FAILURES"` (failed installs only), `"ALL"` (success and failure).

QuietApplyEnabled.title: Quiet Apply Enabled
QuietApplyEnabled.description: When `true`, the scheduler runs a silent apply pass before the interactive apply phase. Apps whose blocking process is not running are installed without prompting. Items skipped in the silent pass are shown in the interactive dialog as usual.

DeadlineDaysFocus.title: Deadline Days Focus
DeadlineDaysFocus.description: Days a pending update must be present before Focus/DND auto-deferral is disabled and the user must be prompted regardless of Focus state. `0` means Focus is always respected.

DeadlineDaysHard.title: Deadline Days Hard
DeadlineDaysHard.description: Days a pending update must be present before no further deferrals are offered and the update is applied at the next opportunity. `0` disables hard deadlines.

FocusCheckEnabled.title: Focus Check Enabled
FocusCheckEnabled.description: When `false`, Focus/DND and display assertions (e.g. active screen sharing) are never checked. The prompt is shown regardless of the user's Focus state.

FocusIgnoredProcesses.title: Focus Ignored Processes
FocusIgnoredProcesses.description: Space-separated list of process names to ignore when checking for display-sleep assertions (`pmset -g assertions`). If the process holding the assertion resolves to a name that matches an entry here (case-insensitive), the assertion is not treated as a blocker and patching may proceed.

AggressivePatchDayDeferral.title: Aggressive Patch Day Deferral
AggressivePatchDayDeferral.description: When `true`, deferral options are progressively capped as the patching window closes. Options shrink from 2 hours early in the day to 5 minutes near window end, then deferral is removed entirely once the window closes. When `false`, the full `DeferralTimerMenu` list is always shown. Applies to both monthly and deadline mode on the final patch day.
